nodes.label: LoopCoder-v2: Parallel Loop Transformer for Code
nodes.rationale: 7B parameter PLT coder trained on 18T tokens; studies loop-count selection through gain-cost trade-off between representational refinement and CLP-induced positional mismatch.

nodes.label: Parallel Loop Transformer (PLT)
nodes.rationale: Architecture reducing sequential looping cost through cross-loop position offsets (CLP) and shared-KV gated sliding-window attention (G-SWA); enables parallel loop execution with near-constant latency and memory.

nodes.label: Cross-Loop Position Offset (CLP)
nodes.rationale: Mechanism breaking sequential inter-loop dependencies by right-shifting previous loop's hidden states before adding to input; enables parallelism but introduces positional mismatch at loop boundaries.

nodes.label: Intrinsic Offset Cost (Ω)
nodes.rationale: Quantifies CLP-induced positional mismatch as mean Euclidean distance between adjacent token representations; remains approximately constant across loops while per-loop refinement gains diminish.

nodes.label: Per-Loop Hidden-State Dynamics Analysis
nodes.rationale: Tracks step size, angular change, effective rank, and fixed-point gap across loops; reveals that loop 2 provides main productive refinement while later loops yield diminishing, oscillatory updates.

nodes.label: Attention Heat-Map Evolution Analysis
nodes.rationale: Measures attention entropy, inter-loop KL divergence, and head diversity; shows information routing largely freezes after loop 2 with heads becoming increasingly redundant.

nodes.label: Output-Distribution Shift Analysis
nodes.rationale: Tracks logit-lens rank, inter-loop KL divergence, and output entropy; reveals per-loop prediction change collapses after loop 2 while overall predictions sharpen monotonically.

nodes.label: Loop-Count Selection as Gain-Cost Trade-off
nodes.rationale: Formulates PLT loop-count selection as trade-off between marginal refinement gain from additional loops and positional-mismatch cost from CLP offset; explains saturation at r=2.

nodes.label: Effective Rank as Representation Diversity Metric
nodes.rationale: Measures geometric diversity of token representations using normalized singular values; peaks at loop 2 and declines for deeper loops, indicating representational narrowing.

nodes.label: Logit Lens Rank Analysis
nodes.rationale: Tracks rank of ground-truth next token under output distribution across loops; monotonically decreasing rank indicates iterative refinement toward correct prediction.

nodes.label: Thinking Model with Explicit CoT
nodes.rationale: Variant of LoopCoder-v2 fine-tuned to emit explicit reasoning trace; shows super-additive gains when combined with latent loop refinement on reasoning-intensive tasks.

nodes.label: Gated Sliding-Window Attention (G-SWA)
nodes.rationale: Fuses full-context attention on frozen loop-1 KV cache with sliding-window attention over current loop's KV; keeps KV-cache memory independent of loop count.

nodes.label: Macroscopic View of Loop-Count Effect
nodes.rationale: Measures downstream task performance across loop counts under matched training/tuning; establishes non-monotonic trend with peak at r=2.

nodes.label: Microscopic View of Per-Loop Computation
nodes.rationale: Battery of per-loop diagnostic lenses examining hidden-state dynamics, attention evolution, and output-distribution shift to explain macroscopic performance curve.
